name: Gochujang Scallion Cornbread With Honey Butter Glaze

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line a 9-by-23-cm baking pan with two 23-cm wide strips of parchment paper so all sides are covered with a 2.5-cm overhang. Using softened butter, generously grease parchment; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, thoroughly whisk together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, smoked paprika, and salt; set aside.
In a small mixing bowl, thoroughly whisk together sugar, butter, olive oil, honey, milk, gochujang, and eggs.
Whisk wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined. Using a flexible spatula, fold in chopped scallions.
Scrape batter into prepared pan and bake until top is golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean, about 30 minutes. Let cool in baking pan until no longer hot, about 10 minutes.
Lift parchment overhang to gently remove cornbread and place on a wire rack set within a 13-by-46-cm baking sheet.

For the Glaze: In a small saucepan set over medium heat, combine butter, honey, gochujang, and salt, whisking until butter is melted and mixture is smooth, about 2 minutes. Pour over the top of warm cornbread, and, using a spatula or the back of a spoon, gently spread evenly across the surface, allowing excess glaze to drip off cornbread as needed. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds, if desired. Let cool to room temperature, 20 to 30 minutes.

description: This scallion cornbread gets a kick from gochujang, while a light coating of honey butter provides a touch of sweet, salty flavor.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Roasted white sesame seeds, for serving (optional)

Make-ahead and storage: Cornbread can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days. To freeze, portion cornbread into squares, wrap tightly with foil, then place in a zip-top bag and seal. Cornbread can be kept frozen for up to 3 months and reheated from frozen in a 175°C (350°F) oven until warmed through, about 10 minutes.
author: Caroline Choe
